name: Evidence gate for chat answers
owner_decision: Bambang 2026-09-25: chat answers go through a hook; an answer that fails is held and must be corrected (not only warned). Same day: add T5 (quantities) and T6 (outside-system state read in this turn); trial T7 (status wording) on the session transcript before deciding.
single_source: This file is the ONLY place the G-03 rules are written. scripts/hooks/g03.py reads it; SKILL.md files point here.
binds: Every text Claude writes to the owner in the current turn (from the owner's latest message to the end of the turn). Enforced by the Stop hook scripts/hooks/stop.py: the turn cannot end while a check fails.
evidence: A token counts as verified only when it appears in a real tool result of this session (the transcript) or in the owner's own messages. A `code` token may also match the name of a tool that was called successfully, or a path / command such a call was given. An issue key, pageId or workflow id may also match the object a successful non-Bash read was aimed at. Hook messages and Claude's own text are never evidence.

checks.name: TOKENS_FROM_A_SOURCE
checks.rule: Every checkable token in the answer (token_kinds below) appears in some tool result of this session or in an owner message, unless its sentence carries the unverified marker.

checks.name: OUTSIDE_SYSTEMS_READ_LIVE
checks.rule: A sentence that names an outside system (system_rules) and carries a token of the listed kinds: every such token appears in the result of a tool that reads that system directly (not a local copy), unless the sentence carries the unverified marker. 2026-09-25: a GitHub branch was reported as existing at 22bdede from a stale local git ref.

checks.name: ABSENCE_NEEDS_A_SOURCE
checks.rule: A sentence with absence wording (absence_phrases) carries the unverified marker, or holds at least one token that passes T1 (and T2 where it applies).

checks.name: CORRECTION_AFTER_A_HOLD
checks.rule: A text that fails T1-T3, T5-T7 is not unsaid. Each of its problems is resolved only by a later text in the same turn that starts with correction_prefix, itself passes, and restates the failing token, quantity or wording, verified or with the unverified marker.

checks.name: QUANTITIES_COUNTED
checks.rule: A number (digits or an Indonesian / English number word) directly followed by a counting unit (count_units) is backed only when some source shows the same number within count_window characters of a synonym of the same unit, or when a counting command (wc -l, grep -c, Grep count mode, git rev-list --count) returned it. 2026-09-25: '60 kasus' was stated before any count and passed T1 only because 60 appeared in an unrelated result.

checks.name: OUTSIDE_STATE_READ_THIS_TURN
checks.rule: For the fresh_kinds of a system rule (a GitHub commit id, the current version of a Confluence page), the token must come from a live read of that system made in this turn, not an earlier one. Ids that never change (a pageId, a comment id, a workflow id) are not bound; branch and file names are not bound either (owner 2026-09-25: binding them held plans and explanations, 35 holds on the session replay).

checks.name: STATUS_NEEDS_A_SOURCE
checks.rule: A sentence with status wording (status_words) carries the unverified marker or at least one verified non-number token. Runs only when status_words.enabled is true.

override: Only the owner can type it. When the owner's latest message contains it, the Stop hook lets that turn's answer through unchecked. If g03.py itself fails, the answer is held (fail closed) until it is fixed or the owner overrides.

token_kinds.commit: git commit id: 7-40 hex characters holding both a digit and a letter a-f
token_kinds.comment_id: c + 5-6 digits (Jira / Confluence comment id); matches c50237 or a bare "id": "50237"
token_kinds.workflow_id: 16 characters, letters and digits, mixed case (n8n workflow id)
token_kinds.number: any other number written with digits
token_kinds.code: inline `code` without spaces (a path, branch, file or field name); `file.py:120` must be a Read of that file that showed line 120
token_kinds.quote: text between "...", “...” or 「...」 of 4+ characters: found verbatim (whitespace and markup ignored) in a source

status_words.note: Owner 2026-09-25: the first trial list (lolos, gagal, terbuka, selesai, aktif, terdaftar, terkirim, sama persis) held 38 sentences on the session replay, about half of them not claims; owner chose option 2 - this narrow list, conditional sentences and quoted words skipped. Re-trial held 7 sentences (about 5 real status claims, 2 word lists); owner enabled it the same day.

skip: fenced code blocks (``` ... ```): commands and examples, not claims
sentences that carry the unverified marker
known_limits: A token found in a source proves the token exists there, not that the sentence reads it correctly.
Sentences without a checkable token (plain wording, no id, number, date, code or counted quantity) cannot be checked, except for absence wording (T3) and, when enabled, status wording (T7).
Small numbers without a unit are found in almost any tool result, so T1 is weak for them; T5 binds only numbers followed by a listed unit.
T5 accepts the number near the unit anywhere in a source; it does not prove the count refers to the same set of things.
System detection (T2, T6) is a word list per sentence; a sentence about GitHub that never says GitHub / origin/ / remote is not bound.
Hooks run as the same OS user as the model: they stop shortcuts and forgetting, not a deliberate attack.
